passive.name: deadeye
passive.description: Hitting the same enemy twice within 4 s (120 ticks) reveals it through cover for 3 s (90 ticks).
passive.notes: Selected stock form. Full mechanics and rank transformations are authoritative in mechanics. Concept sheet: deadeye, hitting the same target twice reveals it for 3 s. The marked state, extra stability and the camera drone are proposals. Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 statuses[0].whenN = 2 (The sheet says "same target twice"; the second hit within the window is the trigger (when nth, whenN 2).); rank 0 statuses: revealed 90 ticks; rank 3 statuses[0].whenN = 2 (The sheet says "same target twice"; the second hit within the window is the trigger (when nth, whenN 2).); rank 3 effects[0].perApplication = 10 (The sheet gives no augmented effect for deadeye; extra stability damage against a revealed target and the marked state are proposed to reward the follow-up.); rank 3 statuses: revealed 108 ticks, marked 108 ticks; rank 5 statuses[0].whenN = 2 (The sheet says "same target twice"; the second hit within the window is the trigger (when nth, whenN 2).); rank 5 effects[0].perApplication = 10 (Kept from the rank 3 form.); rank 5 camera drone = "drone, 90 hp, 120 ticks, refreshes reveal every 30 ticks" (Her camera arm detaches as a drone that hovers over the revealed target and refreshes the reveal every 1 s; the drone is the carrier of this form.); rank 5 statuses: revealed 120 ticks, marked 120 ticks.

dossier.identity: long-range ghost who sees through cover, bends shots off walls and leaves holograms where she was~ :3
dossier.selectionRationale: the lane-length precision striker: aria's arrows trade range for rate, sol's beam is a fixed line, while sable reveals, ricochets and misdirects, giving the squad a scout-sniper that wins by information rather than burst.
dossier.weaponConcept: vector longshot (long-range precision rifle with modular optics, split phase-round barrel, rail assembly, bullpup stock, crystal signal-analysis scope and two shoulder drone-camera arms)

lore.backstory: former overwatch analyst for the transit authority who got tired of reporting what she saw to people who would not act on it~ uwu. she took a longshot rail from the evidence locker and the two camera arms with it, and has been showing the city its blind spots since.
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for unlicensed overwatch of the ring road, for returning forty-one stolen drones to their owners with their footage deleted, and for the phrase painted across a security tower at night.
lore.psychProfile: quiet, watchful and amused, says very little and reveals everything else xo.
lore.combatQuote: “i see things you didn't, bestie~ distance makes honesty :3”

iconFamily.subject: a bold ghost bending a single chunky ricochet line
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Sable. Theme: vector ghost. Subject: a bold ghost bending a single chunky ricochet line. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
